===Levels 33–52/74: Oak larders === From level 33 to 52, build [[oak larder]]s in the [[Kitchen]]. Oak larders require 8 [[oak plank]]s to build, and they grant 480 experience each. Players can gain up to around 480,000 experience per hour from level 50 onwards.
